name: GitHub
description: Official GitHub integration for Chattree. Inspect repositories, list your projects, view issues, read READMEs, search code, create issues, and manage tokens using natural language or slash commands.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.0.6: Added README reading (phase 6), code search (phase 7), and issue creation (phase 8). All via natural language in WASM.

tools.description: Interactúa con GitHub en lenguaje natural o con comandos: /github que repos tengo, /github quien soy, /github <owner/repo>, /github issues <owner/repo>, o /github config <token>.
